_about: One priority order for every project process (B7350-B7359; the owner's picks on the Process Priority Desk, 18 November 2026, all as recommended). Every tool that orders work reads this file through tools/pcq/prio.mjs; none keeps its own list. docs/PRIORITIES.md explains it in plain words. Check it with: node tools/pcq/prio.mjs check

ranks.name: PR gates

aging._about: B6490 kept, but a job only climbs inside its own rank (desk pick p4)

preempt._about: A higher rank never ends a running job. A lower job hands its lanes over at the next gate and its unfinished gates go back to the queue as the same job (desk pick p3). Needs the runner's rerun-only-unfinished-gates fix first.
